sms.title: SMS commands
sms.description: What to send by SMS to which truck. Send a text from your phone to the truck's SIM number; the unit answers to the phone that sent it.
sms.syntax: Every text has the form command#password[#parameters].
sms.caseInsensitive: Commands and the password are case-insensitive.
sms.maxBytes: A text to the unit may be at most 64 bytes; the unit does not accept a longer one.
sms.replyTo: The unit sends its reply to the phone number that sent the command.
sms.noPasswordHint: No Simple SMS password is stored for this device, so its texts cannot be prepared. Add the password (parameter 0593) in the device editor.
sms.copyByHand: The browser did not allow copying. The text is selected: press Ctrl+C, or tap Copy on a phone.
sms.openSmsLabel: Open {text} in the SMS app, addressed to {sim}
sms.tooLong: {bytes} bytes: longer than 64 bytes, so the unit does not accept it.
sms.firstDevices: The Branch has {total} devices; this page lists the first {shown}.
sms.karmaWarning: Emergency only. After these texts the unit reports to Karma, and holita receives none of its data until you route it back to holita.

check.title: Check the unit
check.description: These texts only read; they change nothing on the unit. Use them to see whether the unit answers and which server it reports to.

route.title: Route to holita
route.description: Makes holita (65.108.137.165, port 11500) the unit's primary server. Send the two texts in this order and send the second one only after the reply ok#setparam to the first. About 10 minutes later check the result with getparam 49 and 50. If the unit does not come online, call its SIM number to wake it.

karma.title: Emergency: back to Karma
karma.description: Makes Karma (in.karma.online, port 500) the unit's primary server again. Send the two texts in this order and send the second one only after the reply ok#setparam to the first.

info.when: To see that the unit is alive and answers SMS, and to read its model, serial number, firmware, GSM operator and signal, IP address and voltages.
info.reply: One line such as StarLink-CT 2e1-XL #02A23F 2.34; 05/11 06:22; "ORANGE" (425001) …; the fields depend on the firmware.

loc.when: To see where the truck is when it is not online. The unit answers with its last known position and does not switch GNSS on for it.
loc.reply: Event: Location; In: …; Out: …; LocTime: …; Speed: …; Link: http://maps.google.com/?q=…

getparam49.when: To see which server the unit sends its data to.
getparam49.reply: 65.108.137.165 when the unit is routed to holita; in.karma.online when it reports to Karma.

getparam50.reply: 11500 when the unit is routed to holita; 500 when it reports to Karma.

getparam51.when: To check the backup server that the unit uses when its primary server does not answer.

getparam52.reply: 500, the port of the Karma backup server.

route49.purpose: Step 1: holita's address as the primary server
route49.when: The first text when you route the unit to holita.

route50.when: Send it after the reply to step 1.
route50.reply: ok#setparam. The unit then connects to holita.

karma49.purpose: Step 1: Karma's address as the primary server

karma50.when: Send it after the reply to step 1.
karma50.reply: ok#setparam. The unit then reports to Karma again.

snapshots.title: Read parameters
snapshots.hint: holita reads the unit's stored parameters one by one, except the routing parameters 0049–0054. It takes a few minutes and changes nothing on the unit.
snapshots.secretNote: Values are shown unmasked, including passwords.
snapshots.confirmMessage: holita now reads the stored parameters of {unit} one by one. Nothing on the unit changes.
snapshots.startFailed: The parameter read did not start
snapshots.changes: Changes since the previous complete read
snapshots.noChanges: No changes, or no earlier complete read to compare with.

settings.title: Device settings
settings.hint: One controlled change per unit. A write first reads the parameters again, reads the baseline, writes and reads back. A mismatch restores the exact baseline. An uncertain submission is never replayed.
settings.primaryRequired: A primary connection to holita is required.
settings.writesDisabled: Configuration writes are disabled by the server. Read-only eData inspection is available.
settings.definitionHint: Exactly one 22-byte definition. Existing IDs and unrelated records are protected.
settings.globalsHint: Complete 49-byte value. Readback must match every byte.
settings.confirm: {operation} for {target}. The workflow records every step and the result.
settings.uncertain: The request could not be confirmed. Refresh the run history before submitting again.

queue.title: Queue a device read
queue.hint: The six supported reads wait for a primary connection. A request expires after the chosen time and can be cancelled while queued. Acceptance is not a unit reply.
queue.identityNote: The audit records the verified session identity for this organization.
queue.intentHint: Optional operator note; the selected action is recorded when blank.
queue.empty: No command requests for this device.
queue.unavailable: The command request could not be confirmed.
queue.uncertainSubmission: The request may have been saved. Review the audit before deciding what to do; do not repeat it automatically.
queue.confirmMessage: {action} for {unit}. Wait for its primary connection for up to {minutes} minutes.
queue.cancelMessage: Cancel {action} for {unit}? Cancellation is possible only before submission.
queue.uncertain: Delivery is uncertain. This request will never be replayed automatically. Inspect its wire evidence before another decision.
